command: taskset -c 8-25 docker version && taskset -c 8-25 docker run --rm --cpuset-cpus=8-23 hello-world
success_condition: Docker daemon is reachable by user yang and the cpuset-constrained smoke exits zero.
failure_policy: Wait for the user-owned sudo installation/group refresh. Do not use rootless Docker or pull AHA images before this check passes.
